statBlock.name: Baphomet
statBlock.description: The Horned King hunts trespassers through a labyrinth that can seal its passages and twist the rooms around them.

sections.Damage immunities: Poison. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage when the damage is nonmagical.
sections.Traits:
Charge. Move at least 10 ft. straight toward a target before hitting it with Gore on the same turn to deal an extra 16 (3d10) piercing damage. A creature hit must pass a DC 25 Strength save or be pushed up to 10 ft. away and knocked prone.
Labyrinthine Recall. Baphomet remembers every path he has traveled perfectly and is immune to Maze.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Baphomet can turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Magic Resistance. Baphomet has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Baphomet’s weapon attacks are magical.
Reckless. At the start of his turn, Baphomet can gain advantage on melee weapon attack rolls for that turn. If he does, attack rolls against him have advantage until the start of his next turn.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Heartcleaver attack, one Bite attack, and one Gore attack.
Heartcleaver. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (2d10 + 10) slashing damage.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (2d8 + 10) piercing damage.
Gore. Melee weapon attack, +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d6 + 10) piercing damage.
Frightful Presence. Each chosen creature within 120 ft. that is aware of Baphomet must make a DC 18 Wisdom save or become frightened for 1 minute. Each affected creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, with disadvantage if Baphomet is in its line of sight. A successful save ends the effect. When the creature saves successfully or the effect otherwise ends, it is immune to this Frightful Presence for 24 hours.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Use Charisma (spell save DC 18). These spells require no material components.
At will. Detect Magic.
3/day each. Dispel Magic, Dominate Beast, Hunter’s Mark, Maze, Wall of Stone.
1/day. Teleport.
sections.Legendary actions:
Baphomet has 3 legendary actions. Use one option at a time, at the end of another creature’s turn. He regains spent actions at the start of his turn and must be able to act. If surprised, he first has to complete his first turn.
Heartcleaver Attack (1 action). Make one Heartcleaver attack.
Charge (2 actions). Move up to Baphomet’s speed, then make one Gore attack.
sections.Lair actions:
On initiative count 20, losing ties, choose one magical effect. Baphomet cannot choose the same effect two rounds in a row. He must be able to act. If surprised, he first has to complete his first turn.
Seal an entrance. Fill one unoccupied doorway or other entrance within the lair with solid stone. The stone lasts for 1 minute or until Baphomet uses this option again.
Reverse gravity. Choose a room within the lair no larger than 100 ft. in any dimension. Gravity reverses there until the next initiative count 20. Creatures and objects in the room fall in the new direction unless they can stay aloft. Baphomet can ignore the reversal if he is in the room.
Mirage Arcane. Cast Mirage Arcane on one room within the lair no larger than 100 ft. in any dimension. The spell ends on the next initiative count 20.
sections.Regional effects:
Plants within 1 mile of the lair grow into dense walls that form small mazes.
Beasts within 1 mile of the lair become frightened and disoriented. They may panic or lash out without an obvious threat.
A humanoid that spends at least 1 hour within 1 mile of the lair must pass a DC 18 Wisdom save or gain a flaw from Madness of Baphomet. A successful save grants immunity to this regional effect for 24 hours.
If Baphomet dies, these regional effects fade over 1d10 days.
sections.Madness of Baphomet:
If a creature goes mad in the lair or within Baphomet’s line of sight, roll d100 for a flaw that persists until cured.
01–20. Once provoked, the creature is too angry to listen to reason.
21–40. The creature slips into animal behavior.
41–60. The creature treats the world as its hunting ground and other people as prey.
61–80. The creature slips easily from hatred into rage.
81–00. The creature regards anyone who opposes it as fair game.

statBlock.name: Berbalang
statBlock.description: This collector of secrets questions the dead and sends a spectral double to spy on the living.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claws attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Spectral Duplicate (recharges after a short or long rest). Create one spectral duplicate in a visible, unoccupied space within 60 ft. The berbalang is unconscious while the duplicate exists and can have only one duplicate at a time. The duplicate has the same statistics and knowledge as the berbalang. Everything it experiences becomes known to the berbalang, and its attacks deal psychic damage in place of their normal damage types. The duplicate disappears when it or the berbalang reaches 0 HP, or when the berbalang dismisses it without spending an action.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Use Intelligence (spell save DC 13). These spells require no material components.
At will. Speak with Dead.
1/day. Plane Shift (self only).

statBlock.name: Black Abishai
statBlock.description: This winged devil hides in darkness that it can move across the battlefield.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered.
sections.Traits:
Devil’s Sight. Magical darkness does not block the abishai’s darkvision.
Magic Resistance. The abishai has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. The abishai’s weapon attacks are magical.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Scimitar attacks and one Bite attack.
Scimitar. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) acid damage.
Creeping Darkness (Recharge 6). Cast Darkness on a point within 120 ft. without components, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.
sections.Bonus actions:
Shadow Stealth. The abishai can Hide while in dim light or darkness.
Move Creeping Darkness. While its Darkness spell from Creeping Darkness persists, the abishai can move that area of darkness up to 60 ft.

statBlock.name: Blue Abishai
statBlock.description: This winged devil studies wizardry and carries a quarterstaff.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered.
sections.Traits:
Devil’s Sight. Magical darkness does not block the abishai’s darkvision.
Magic Resistance. The abishai has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. The abishai’s weapon attacks are magical.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Quarterstaff attack and one Bite attack.
Quarterstaff. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage when wielded with two hands.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d10 + 2) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) lightning damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
The abishai casts as a 13th-level wizard using Intelligence (spell save DC 20, +12 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Friends, Mage Hand, Message, Minor Illusion, Shocking Grasp.
Level 1 (4 slots). Chromatic Orb, Disguise Self, Expeditious Retreat, Magic Missile, Charm Person, Thunderwave.
Level 2 (3 slots). Darkness, Mirror Image, Misty Step.
Level 3 (3 slots). Dispel Magic, Fear, Lightning Bolt.
Level 4 (3 slots). Dimension Door, Greater Invisibility, Ice Storm.
Level 5 (2 slots). Cone of Cold, Wall of Force.
Level 6 (1 slot). Chain Lightning.
Level 7 (1 slot). Teleport.

statBlock.name: Boneclaw
statBlock.description: A failed lich can return as this long-clawed undead, bound to a cruel master. Destroying its body buys time while that bond holds.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, necrotic. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Languages: Common plus the main language of its master.
sections.Traits: Rejuvenation. If destroyed while its master lives, the boneclaw returns in 1d10 hours at full HP. Its new body appears within 1 mile of its master.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Piercing Claw attacks.
Piercing Claw. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (3d10 + 4) piercing damage. The boneclaw can pull a creature hit up to 10 ft. closer, and the creature is grappled (escape DC 14). The boneclaw has two claws. While a claw is grappling a creature, it can attack only that creature.
Shadow Jump. If the boneclaw is in dim light or darkness, each creature it chooses within 5 ft. makes a DC 14 Constitution save or takes 34 (5d12 + 2) necrotic damage. The boneclaw then magically teleports up to 60 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space. It can take one creature it is grappling, placing it in a visible, unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the boneclaw’s destination. Both destinations must be in dim light or darkness.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Stealth. The boneclaw can Hide while in dim light or darkness.
sections.Reactions: Deadly Reach. When an enemy the boneclaw can see moves into its reach, it makes one Piercing Claw attack against the enemy. If that attack hits, it can make a second Piercing Claw attack against the same target.

statBlock.name: Bronze Scout
statBlock.description: This burrowing clockwork scout sends lightning through the ground when enemies get close.

sections.Damage immunities: Poison. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned.
sections.Languages: Understands one language of its creator but can't speak.
sections.Traits:
Earth Armor. Burrowing does not provoke opportunity attacks for the bronze scout.
Magic Resistance. The bronze scout has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) lightning damage.
Lightning Flare (recharges after a short or long rest). Every creature touching the ground within 15 ft. makes a DC 13 Dexterity save, taking 14 (4d6) lightning damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.
